This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England. The competition will be located on the 6th floor of the MIT Media Lab in the Silverman Skyroom. Due to the nature of the space, the entrance will be monitered by a member of our staff at all times to let competitors in.
